affected_boundaries: required coverage to configured directional rules

observed_behavior: GWEN-001 reports traceability valid: 0 rules despite 978 required coverage gaps.
expected_behavior: Indexed validation always checks mandatory implementation, unit-test or disposition, integration-test and UAT coverage in the selected scope.
causal_mechanism: The indexed validator iterates only optional schema V4 directional rules; earlier configurations normalize to an empty rule list.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Treat optional policy extensions as the entire validation policy.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: An empty configured extension list yields a vacuous success without checking required coverage.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Required coverage is unconditional; custom rules add to it.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Share a typed canonical set of required coverage rules with the structural checker. Match registered artifact classes independently of declared entity kinds; preserve all classes when a file is registered more than once.

applicability_conditions: Projects with no custom directional rules, custom entity kinds, or multiple classes for one artifact.
known_non_matches: Structural source validation and TypeScript semantic checks remain separate commands.
confirmation_evidence: GWEN-001 now exits 1 and reports 978 gaps across 305 requirements, matching the structural audit.
Real CLI fixture without custom rules reports three missing classes and passes after all required coverage is added.
